messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident SEV-2: High latencies on gen-inference in eu-west-1. Auto-pager triggered 1782302468. Eng oncall @maria.gonzalez, FYI.

maria.gonzalez: grabbing it. starting triage. pinging oncall rotation for overlap.

ashwin: I'm in for overlap — can take 30m to 1h while maria gets context. what customer impact messaging do we need?

maria.gonzalez: customers in EU + APAC seeing increased tail latency for streaming responses. error rate low but timeouts for some long requests. planning status page update + targeted localized notifications.

lisa_t: re: localized notifications — we need translation blurbs and send windows. last time we triggered at midnight CET and woke people up. let's be conscious of regional local times.

ashwin: Agreed. Proposal: Post high-level status page immediately (ENG). Hold targeted email/push translations until local business hours for each region, unless outage escalates.

maria.gonzalez: Draft status page blurb (EN) — please review: 
```
We are investigating increased inference latencies for text-generation in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience streaming timeouts or slower token throughput. Engineers are actively mitigating; we will provide updates every 30 minutes.
```

lisa_t: LGTM. I'll prepare translated blurbs for FR/ES/JA. Post notes on timing: EU pushes at 09:00-18:00 CET, NA pushes at 09:00-18:00 local ET/PT windows, APAC pushes at 09:00-18:00 local JST/AEST windows. If incident escalates to SEV1 or customer-impacting errors >1% we fire immediate push irrespective of local time.

dave_sre: For automation, we can use incident-broadcast job with region tag. Suggested cron windows (UTC): 
- EU: 08:00-17:00 UTC (map to CET/BST)
- NA: 13:00-22:00 UTC (ET/PT overlap)
- APAC: 00:00-09:00 UTC (JST/AEST)
Use `--hold-until` flag for immediate escalations.

maria.gonzalez: Lisa — can you paste FR/ES/JA blurbs? I'll attach to status page update once validated.

lisa_t: sure — pasting below: 
```
FR: Nous investiguons une augmentation des latences pour la génération de texte dans eu-west-1. Certains clients peuvent rencontrer des délais d'attente pour les flux en continu. Nos ingénieurs travaillent sur une mitigation; mises à jour toutes les 30 minutes.
ES: Estamos investigando un aumento de latencias en la generación de texto en eu-west-1. Algunos clientes pueden experimentar tiempos de espera o respuestas más lentas. Ingenieros trabajando; actualizaciones cada 30 minutos.
JA: eu-west-1 のテキスト生成でレイテンシが増加しています。継続ストリーミングがタイムアウトする可能性があります。エンジニアが対応中です。30分ごとに状況を更新します。
```

ashwin: Nice. Two ops notes: (1) include a short machine-readable tag in the payload so downstream translators can detect language (e.g., `lang:fr`), (2) add `send_policy` field: `immediate|business-hours|deferred` so we can automate per-customer settings.

maria.gonzalez: Good call. Our customer-impact assessment: 3 enterprise customers (EU) with aggressive SLAs may need immediate email + AM alert to their CSMs. I'll list them to SRE lead DM.

oncall-bot: Incident timeline note added. Incident commander: maria.gonzalez. Channel bridge: #inc-bridge-1782302468. Next update scheduled 1782304268 (+30m).

dave_sre: Handoff note for next oncall: please carry send_policy decisions. If we ramp to SEV1 (error rate >1% or >5% customers affected), override to `immediate`. Also document per-region send times in the handoff template: 
```
Region: EU
Send window UTC: 08:00-17:00
Default send_policy: business-hours
Override: immediate if SEV1 or customer-impacting SLA
```

maria.gonzalez: adding to postmortem checklist. Also adding a short internal comms template for CSMs to forward to customers: 
```
Subject: Service update — increased inference latency in eu-west-1
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're investigating increased latencies affecting inference in eu-west-1 which may impact streaming responses. Engineers are mitigating; we'll send updates every 30 minutes. If you'd like direct escalation, reply and we'll route to your technical account owner.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
```

lisa_t: I'll queue translated CSM templates and set `send_policy: immediate` for the three EU enterprise customers. For the rest, `business-hours`.

ashwin: quick ops checklist before we broadcast: 1) confirm circuit breaker config for long-running streams 2) adjust prefix caching for common prompts 3) enable fallback replica in gw-region for EU tenants. Maria, confirm when we hit all three then I'll run the region-broadcast.

maria.gonzalez: Got it. Working on 1/3 now. Will update when done.

oncall-bot: Next scheduled handoff: 1782306120. Please ensure the handoff message includes active `send_policy` map and list of prioritized customers.

maria.gonzalez: update: mitigation (fallback replica routing) applied for 60% of affected traffic. Error rate dropping. posting status page update in 5. will include translated blurbs and per-region send_policy.

lisa_t: thanks — standing by to trigger region broadcast. :thumbsup:
